definitions.explanation: The formal rules and regulations established by a school that students must follow. Covers dress code, behavior, hairstyle, and other aspects of student conduct.

examples.japanese: うちの{学校|がっこう}は{校則|こうそく}が{厳|きび}しい。
{時代|じだい}に{合|あ}わない{校則|こうそく}を{見直|みなお}すべきだという{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: There are calls to review school rules that are out of step with the times.

notes:
USAGE:
{校則|こうそく} combines {校|こう} (school) and {則|そく} (rule). In Japan, school rules have been a topic of debate, with some critics calling overly strict rules ブラック{校則|こうそく} (unreasonable school rules).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {校則|こうそく}を{守|まも}る (to follow school rules)
- {校則|こうそく}に{違反|いはん}する (to violate school rules)
- {校則|こうそく}を{見直|みなお}す (to review school rules)
- {厳|きび}しい{校則|こうそく} (strict school rules)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{規則|きそく} is the general word for rules or regulations in any context. {校則|こうそく} is specifically for school rules.
